references.text: The same age requirement (30–50 years) for Levitical service is mentioned earlier in the same chapter for the sons of Kohath.
Identical age requirements apply to the sons of Gershon who were to serve at the tent of meeting.
The same age requirement (30–50 years) applies to the sons of Merari in their service.
Summary of the counting of the sons of Merari with the same age requirement.
An alternative age limit (25–50 years) for Levitical service, showing variation in the regulations.
David counted the Levites from 30 years and upward, in accordance with the original age limit.
David changed the age limit for Levitical service to 20 years due to changed circumstances.
Jesus began his ministry when he was about 30 years old, which may be linked to the Levitical tradition for starting service.
